name: Instituto Nacional de Estadística y Censos (INDEC)
description: National statistical institute of Argentina, publishing census results, consumer price indices, household income surveys, and economic indicators.
publisher: Instituto Nacional de Estadística y Censos

name: Departamento Administrativo Nacional de Estadística (DANE)
description: National statistical office of Colombia, responsible for the population census, GDP estimates, consumer prices, and household surveys.

name: Instituto Nacional de Estadística e Informática (INEI)
description: Peru's national statistical institute, producing census data, poverty and employment statistics, national accounts, and departmental indicators.
publisher: Instituto Nacional de Estadística e Informática

name: General Statistics Office of Viet Nam (GSO)
description: Vietnam's national statistical agency, publishing census results, the Statistical Yearbook, and monthly economic and social indicators.
publisher: General Statistics Office of Viet Nam

name: Pakistan Bureau of Statistics
description: Pakistan's national statistical agency, conducting the population census and publishing price, labor, trade, and national accounts statistics.

name: Federal State Statistics Service (Rosstat)

name: General Authority for Statistics (GASTAT)

name: National Bureau of Statistics (Nigeria)

name: Hellenic Statistical Authority (ELSTAT)

name: National Institute of Statistics (Romania)

name: e-Stat

name: KOSIS

name: International Monetary Fund
description: Global financial institution monitoring exchange rates and macroeconomic stability, publishing research, country reports, and the World Economic Outlook.

name: World Inequality Database

name: Congressional Budget Office

name: The Bank of Korea
description: Central bank of South Korea, publishing monetary policy decisions, financial stability reports, and economic statistics through its ECOS database.

name: Central Bank of Chile
description: Central bank of Chile publishing monetary policy decisions, financial stability reports, and statistical series on prices, accounts, and the balance of payments.

name: Monetary Authority of Singapore
description: Central bank and integrated financial regulator of Singapore, publishing monetary policy statements, regulatory notices, and financial sector statistics.

name: World Bank
description: International development institution publishing country profiles, project documents, development research, and operational policies for its member countries.

name: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development
description: Intergovernmental organization of 38 member countries producing policy analysis, statistical indicators, and economic outlooks for members and partners.

name: United Nations

name: UNESCO
description: United Nations agency for education, science, culture, and communication, publishing reports, statistics, and world heritage documentation.

name: World Health Organization
description: United Nations health agency publishing health guidelines, disease outbreak news, country health profiles, and global health statistics.

name: Council of Europe

name: INTERPOL
description: International Criminal Police Organization coordinating police cooperation among its member countries, publishing notices, wanted persons, and crime reports.

name: Met Office
description: The United Kingdom's national weather service, providing forecasts, warnings, climate research, and the Hadley Centre climate monitoring datasets.

name: weather.gc.ca

name: Global Monitoring Laboratory

name: National Snow and Ice Data Center
description: Data center for snow, ice, glaciers, and frozen ground research, distributing sea ice indices, cryosphere datasets, and satellite-derived products.

name: iNaturalist
description: Community platform where users record and identify species observations, producing open biodiversity occurrence data used in research and conservation.

name: FishBase
description: Global database on fish species compiled with scientific experts, covering taxonomy, biology, ecology, and distribution for tens of thousands of species.

name: USGS National Water Information System
description: USGS portal for water quantity and quality data from monitoring sites across the United States, including streamflow, groundwater levels, and water quality samples.

name: PANGAEA
description: Data publisher for earth and environmental science, archiving peer-reviewed datasets with structured metadata, persistent identifiers, and open access.

name: Energy Institute
description: Professional body for the energy sector that publishes the Statistical Review of World Energy, covering production, consumption, and trade of fuels and renewables.

name: ENTSO-E Transparency Platform

name: Open Power System Data
description: Free dataset platform for power system research, providing harmonized generation, load, capacity, and power plant data for European countries.

name: FoodData Central

name: European Food Safety Authority

name: FEWS NET

name: Census Reporter

name: Roper Center for Public Opinion Research

name: AmericasBarometer (LAPOP)

name: Open Syllabus

name: International Association for the Evaluation of Educational Achievement

name: Légifrance

name: wetten.overheid.nl

name: Fedlex

name: e-Gov Law Search

name: AustLII

name: British and Irish Legal Information Institute
description: Charity providing free access to case law and legislation from the United Kingdom, Ireland, and related jurisdictions, including court and tribunal decisions.

name: United States Code
description: Office of the Law Revision Counsel database of the general and permanent laws of the United States, with searchable text, classifications, and downloadable editions.

name: International Crisis Group
description: Independent organization providing field-based analysis and recommendations on preventing and resolving deadly conflict worldwide.

name: Transparency International
description: Global civil society coalition against corruption, publisher of the Corruption Perceptions Index and reports from national chapters.

name: RAND Corporation
description: Nonprofit policy research institute publishing studies on defense, health, education, and international affairs for government and public audiences.

name: Global Terrorism Database

name: Ministry of Corporate Affairs (India)
description: Indian government ministry administering company registration and the MCA21 electronic filing system, providing company master data and filed documents.
publisher: Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India

name: DART
description: Korea's electronic corporate disclosure system, hosting periodic and ad hoc reports such as annual results and major shareholding disclosures of listed companies.

name: Open Ownership
description: Nonprofit promoting beneficial ownership transparency, publishing implementation guidance and the Open Ownership Register of linked disclosures.

name: Offshore Leaks Database

name: Aleph

name: Japan Exchange Group (JPX)

name: B3

name: Harmonized Tariff Schedule

name: UNCTAD
description: United Nations trade and development body publishing trade analysis, investment reports, commodity statistics, and development policy research.

name: Open Contracting Partnership
description: Nonprofit working to open public contracting, publisher of the Open Contracting Data Standard and guidance for procurement disclosure and analysis.

name: Financial Transparency System
description: European Commission portal listing beneficiaries of EU funds directly managed by the Commission, searchable by country, beneficiary, and policy area.

name: Australian Electoral Commission
description: Independent authority running Australian federal elections, publishing results, electorate boundaries, and political finance disclosures.

name: Elections Canada
description: Independent agency administering Canadian federal elections, publishing results, candidate data, riding profiles, and third party finance reports.

name: Tribunal Superior Eleitoral

name: Instituto Nacional Electoral
description: Mexico's electoral authority organizing federal elections and publishing results, voter registry statistics, and campaign finance oversight records.

name: GovTrack.us
description: Independent tracker of United States Congress activity, following bills, votes, and legislators with historical records spanning earlier congresses.

name: FamilySearch

name: Bundesarchiv

name: Deutsche Digitale Bibliothek

name: National Library of Israel
description: National library holding Jewish, Israeli, and Middle Eastern collections, offering catalog search, digitized manuscripts, and archival materials.

name: The Markup

name: Global Investigative Journalism Network
description: Association of investigative journalism organizations sharing training resources, case studies, tool guides, and cross border story collaborations.

name: FRONTLINE

name: Forbidden Stories

name: GDELT Project

name: Television News Archive

name: CORRECTIV

name: Lead Stories

name: UNSCEAR

name: Integrated Risk Information System

name: OpenTopography

name: GEBCO

name: Copernicus

name: NASA FIRMS

name: Digital Earth Africa

name: Digital Earth Australia

name: data.norge.no

name: dados.gov.br

name: data.gov.tw

name: data.go.kr

name: openFDA

name: Guardian Open Platform

name: Zotero

name: kepler.gl

name: Perma.cc
